name: Fiona Taimana
bio: Fiona completed her Masters in Commercialisation and Entrepreneurship at the University Of Auckland Graduate School Of Business in 2020. An experienced creative thinker, she is passionate about innovation and entrepreneurial thinking. Fiona has led marketing, training, and customer experience teams in the United Arab Emirates, India, Middle East, and New Zealand. She shares her experience with AHLab to make science and technology accessible to the next generation, so they can create amazing discoveries to protect their future.
